en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Numan, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Hates the immoral one, the obscene one, and the insistent beggar’.
en.sarwar: 11. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Nu’man from ‘Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following:
“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Allah hates those who use foul language and the insistant beggar.”
